description: Add a website to your LiftMCP organisation as a Property and get the server card to publish on it. Needs your organisation API key in the Authorization header. Safe to repeat: a site already added is found, not added twice. Next: publish the card exactly as given at the address given, then call verify_site.

domain.description: The site, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com

name: register_site
